headline: Trump Ringwalk?
question: Fury or Joshua?
caption:
Tyson Fury says he wants President Trump to walk him to the ring against Anthony Joshua.
Fury or Joshua? 👇

Fury told Sky Sports he will invite Trump to the Dec. 11 heavyweight fight at Principality Stadium in Cardiff, and called the Joshua bout a warm-up for a third fight with Oleksandr Usyk. The event has also sparked a feud between Dana White and Eddie Hearn. Boxing news.

Would you want to see that ringwalk?
